game.spyfall.name: Spyfall
game.spyfall.desc: One player is the spy and does not know where the table is: ask questions, watch who answers too vaguely, and accuse before the spy names the location.
game.spyfall.rule.1: Everyone except the spy knows the location. Ask one player a question each turn and judge their answer.
game.spyfall.rule.2: The spy wins by naming the location; the table wins by accusing the spy before time runs out.
game.spyfall.option.rounds_hint: How many times every seat asks a question before the spy escapes by surviving.
game.spyfall.question.best_time: When is the best time to come?
game.spyfall.question.brought: What did you bring with you?
game.spyfall.question.worst: What is the worst part of this place?
game.spyfall.answer.loud: It gets very loud at night.
game.spyfall.answer.back: We usually keep it in the back.
game.spyfall.answer.sea: It smells of salt and wind.
game.spyfall.answer.staff: Only the staff may touch it.
game.spyfall.answer.silent: We do not talk about that.
game.spyfall.identity_spy: You do not know where the table is. Answer with something that would fit several places and name the location only when the answers give it away.
game.spyfall.identity_unknown: Waiting for the host to send your identity card…
game.spyfall.identity_hint: Pass the device after every action: only the acting player sees this card.
game.spyfall.agents_goal: Answers must fit the location. The spy cannot fake that for long — an accusation that finds the spy wins the match.
game.spyfall.reveal: The spy was {spy} and the location was {location}.
game.spyfall.accuse_hint: An accusation is final: find the spy and the agents win, miss and the spy escapes.
game.spyfall.name_hint: Right: you win at once. Wrong: the agents win.
game.spyfall.log_start: A match with {count} seats: the table asks questions for {rounds} rounds.
game.spyfall.log_reveal: The spy was {spy}; the location was {location}.
game.spyfall.reason_spy_misguessed: The spy named the wrong location.
game.spyfall.error.illegal_action: That is not a legal Spyfall action right now.
